answer.reason: Several verses tell what happened at Jazer: it was taken from the Amorites, built by Gad, and given to the Levites.

clauses.english: was spied out by men sent by Moses, and its villages were taken from the Amorites
clauses.quote: And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer, and they took the villages thereof

clauses.english: was built by the children of Gad
clauses.quote: And Atroth, Shophan, and Jaazer, and Jogbehah,

clauses.english: was given with its suburbs to the Levites of Merari's family
clauses.quote: Heshbon with her suburbs, Jazer with her suburbs; four cities in all.

doubts: NUM 32:1, NUM 32:3 and JOS 13:25 only speak of the land or border of Jazer, so they were left out.
2SA 24:5, ISA 16:8-9 and JER 48:32 give only a location or a simile of weeping, so they were left out.
